B_reduction.notes: Survey t:main (764) and proof chain read (656-892); PD original hence robust (axioms checked directly; src 429; survey 1360). C_core_proof.notes: Lemmas 0-7 checked by hand; no hypothesis weaker than its use; WLOG t>=4 swap valid. The proof uses only PD facts K1-K3. D_small_cases.notes: upperPDn-3 (608), mPDS:n-3:K2t (701-705, t>=2), p:K33 (726), plus K2 and P3/K3, cover exactly the complement of the Core range. Independent scan of all H on 2-6 vertices reproduces every verdict, with no TAR-invariant collisions across different PD families.
